research.title: Research
research.intro: I want to understand how mitochondria supply the cell with energy, and what happens when they fail
research.helixLabel: Turning DNA double helix: the start of human mitochondrial DNA
research.helixCaption: The first 48 base pairs of human mitochondrial DNA (reference sequence rCRS, 16,569 base pairs in total).
research.motivationHeading: From the bedside to the cell
research.motivationClinic: My years in hospital showed me what a disease means for a person's daily life. I bring that perspective into research.
research.motivationMito: Mitochondria power the cell and carry their own genome. When they fail, several organs are often affected at once, above all those with a high energy demand such as the brain, muscle and heart.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.introText: This privacy notice explains which personal data is processed when you visit melinastutz.com or contact me by email: for what purpose, who receives it and how long it is kept. It follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).
privacy.controllerText: The controller is Melina Fabienne Stutz, Merenschwand AG, Switzerland. This is a private, non-commercial website. You can reach me at the email address in the imprint.
privacy.visitText: When you open a page, your browser sends technically necessary information: IP address, date and time, the page requested, the status code, the amount of data transferred, the previously visited page (referrer) and the browser identifier (user agent). This information is used only to deliver the website, protect it from attacks and find errors. It is not used for statistics and not combined with other data. Server logs are deleted automatically after 14 days. If a specific attack or error has to be investigated, the entries concerned are kept until the investigation is complete.
privacy.hostingText: The website runs on a privately operated server in Switzerland. A private individual operates the server on my behalf and may use the data only to run the website. All requests pass through the network of Cloudflare, Inc., San Francisco (USA). Cloudflare provides the encrypted connection, protects the website from attacks and forwards requests to the server. In doing so, Cloudflare processes the connection data listed above on my behalf, in the data centre closest to you (usually in Switzerland for visits from Switzerland) and in the USA. The Swiss Federal Council has recognised that US companies certified under the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework provide adequate data protection (in force since 15 September 2024). Cloudflare, Inc. is certified. For data centres in other countries without adequate protection, Cloudflare relies on the EU standard contractual clauses recognised by the FDPIC.
privacy.noTrackingText: This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics or advertising services and loads no third-party content. It serves its fonts itself. The LinkedIn link is a plain link: LinkedIn receives data only when you click it, and from then on LinkedIn's privacy policy applies. Only if Cloudflare suspects automated access may it set a technically necessary security cookie.
privacy.emailText: If you email me, I process your email address, your name and the content of your message to answer your enquiry. My mailbox is hosted by Apple's iCloud Mail (Apple Distribution International Ltd., Ireland). Apple may also store emails in the USA and other countries and relies on standard contractual clauses for this. I do not pass your messages on to anyone else without your consent. I delete them once they are no longer needed for our correspondence, at the latest after 24 months.
privacy.rightsText: You can ask whether and which personal data I process about you. You can also ask for incorrect data to be corrected, or for data to be deleted or no longer processed. Write to the email address in the imprint; I may ask you to confirm your identity. If you think I am not handling your data correctly, you can report this to the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC) or assert your claims before a civil court.
